title: GNOME libxml2 2.12.6 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlTextReaderConstEncoding()…
description: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability exists in GNOME libxml2 versions 2.12.6 through 2.15.4 in the function xmlTextReaderConstEncoding(). This occurs after a reader is reset with xmlReaderNewWalker(), where the internal context input pointer is left NULL. Querying the document encoding then causes a crash, resulting in denial of service.
